# Celine

Little constexpr linear application engine

## Building

### Using xmake

1. Install the (Xmake build system)[https://xmake.io/]

2. Set debug or release mode :
```bash
xmake config --mode=debug
xmake config --mode=release
```

3. Build, run or test
```bash
xmake
xmake run
xmake test  
```

### Using cmake (autogenerated cmake files by xmake)

1. Install everything yourself...

2. Generate the build files
```bash
cmake -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release # for release
cmake -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug # for debug
```

3. Build the project
```bash
cmake --build build
```
